messages:
leo-partner: FYI marketplace asked for a pilot to move on-prem appliance customers into the marketplace. Proposal: hybrid structure with a short migration allowance + a renewal discount ladder based on commit retention. Need SI + HW + legal signoff before field rollout.

jenna-finance: Good direction. Two finance checks: (1) call the upfront amount a 'migration allowance' for revenue recognition, (2) define rollback triggers if commit falls at renewal. Also need SKU mapping for reconciliation.

omar-ops: Ops note: marketplace listing reviews can vary by region (10-14 business days). If we want a co-announcement, schedule announcement >=6w post-activation. Also request adding `mp_offer_flow` tag to track listing state.

rita-si: SIs prefer success-based rebates over up-front co-funding. Suggest a 30/60/90 payout schedule after cutover verification. Also need SKU-level guidance to price trade-ins.

tom-marketing: For joint marketing we need one verified customer metric and quote. Recommend 8 weeks before announcement to gather results and approvals. I'll prep a partner FAQ and 1-pager.

legal-bot: Reminder to include a clawback clause and avoid forward-looking guarantees in partner language. I'll post a reusable clause.

leo-partner: Draft pilot sketch:
- offer_type: private-offer pilot
- term: 12 months
- migration_allowance: 2x avg monthly usage applied month 1-2
- renewal_discount_ladder: renewals tiered by retention: >=90% -> 15%, 70-89% -> 10%, 50-69% -> 5%
- si_rebate_option: optional, pays out 30/50/20% at 30/60/90 days post-cutover
- listing_timing: allow 3-4w for marketplace review before co-announcement
- reporting_tags: mp_offer_flow, surge_meta_{offerid}
- clawback: prorated repayment if terminated within first 6 months

jenna-finance: Agree. We'll need a reconciliation file with `surge_meta_{offerid}` usage per month.

omar-ops: I'll add tagging backlog (ETA 2w) and flag region listing SLAs.

rita-si: I'll surface SI candidates and trade-in asks by Monday.

tom-marketing: I'll share FAQ + 1-pager draft in 5 days and suggest conservative messaging (no absolute lift guarantees).

legal-bot: Clawback clause uploaded to docs (partners-only).

leo-partner: Actions: Jenna finalize revenue label, Omar add tags, Rita confirm SIs, Tom draft comms, Legal post clause. Scheduling 30m alignment next Tue. Thanks all.
